title: Deduplicate events by id before load
description: Appends every event row directly into the warehouse table.
issue_title: Pipeline does not handle duplicate events
issue_description: Repeated source deliveries can produce duplicate warehouse rows and inflated metrics.
issue_suggestion: Track a stable event id or use an upsert strategy during load.

title: Preserve event time separately from processing time
description: Overwrites the event timestamp with the ingestion clock.
issue_title: Original event time is lost
issue_description: Replacing event_time with processing time breaks late-arrival analysis and time-based reporting.
issue_suggestion: Keep source event time and store processing time in a separate field.

title: Partition fact tables by the query dimension
description: Writes all daily events into one unpartitioned table.
code: CREATE TABLE page_views (event_id STRING, viewed_at TIMESTAMP, user_id STRING);
issue_title: Large event table has no partition strategy
issue_description: Analytical queries will scan more data than needed as volume grows.
issue_suggestion: Partition the table by a commonly filtered timestamp or date column.
issue_code: CREATE TABLE page_views (...) PARTITION BY DATE(viewed_at);

title: Validate schema evolution before append
description: Appends incoming JSON rows without checking for required columns.
code:
def append_batch(rows, table):
    table.append(rows)
issue_title: Schema drift is unchecked
issue_description: Unexpected missing or renamed columns can silently corrupt downstream datasets.
issue_suggestion: Validate rows against the expected schema before appending.

title: Keep raw bronze data immutable
description: Mutates raw source rows in place during cleanup.
issue_title: Raw data lineage is destroyed
issue_description: Mutating the raw layer makes it harder to replay transformations or audit source truth later.
issue_suggestion: Write cleaned data into a derived layer and preserve raw input unchanged.
issue_code: cleaned_rows = [{**row, 'email': row['email'].strip().lower()} for row in rows]

title: Model null handling explicitly in aggregations
description: Sums a nullable revenue field directly.
code:
def total_revenue(rows):
    return sum(row['revenue'] for row in rows)
issue_title: Null revenue values break or skew the aggregation
issue_description: Missing values need an explicit business rule instead of relying on implicit behavior.
issue_suggestion: Normalize or coalesce nullable measures before aggregation.
issue_code: return sum((row['revenue'] or 0) for row in rows)

title: Use idempotent upserts for daily snapshots
description: Inserts one snapshot row per account every run.
issue_title: Repeated runs create duplicate snapshot rows
issue_description: Backfills or reruns will multiply the same logical snapshot unless writes are idempotent.
issue_suggestion: Upsert on the business key plus snapshot date.

title: Do not join facts on free-form text keys
description: Joins orders to campaigns using campaign_name.
code: SELECT * FROM orders o JOIN campaigns c ON o.campaign_name = c.name;
issue_title: Join key is unstable text
issue_description: Names change over time and can collide, causing broken attribution joins.
issue_suggestion: Join on stable surrogate or natural ids instead of labels.

title: Track watermark for incremental loads
description: Reads the full source table on every run.
code:
def extract_all(source):
    return source.query('SELECT * FROM orders')
issue_title: Pipeline does full reloads without incremental state
issue_description: Repeated full extracts waste compute and increase latency as the source grows.
issue_suggestion: Track a watermark such as updated_at and load incrementally.

title: Normalize nested arrays before warehouse load
description: Writes raw arrays directly into a flat analytics table.
code:
def write_items(order):
    warehouse.insert({'order_id': order['id'], 'items': order['items']})
issue_title: Nested array is not modeled for relational analytics
issue_description: Flat warehouse tables become harder to query when arrays are packed into one column without a child table strategy.
issue_suggestion: Explode line items into a separate fact table or use a supported nested schema intentionally.
issue_code:
for item in order['items']:
    warehouse.insert({'order_id': order['id'], 'sku': item['sku']})

title: Handle late-arriving dimension changes
description: Looks up the current plan tier during fact load.
issue_title: Historical fact is enriched with current dimension state
issue_description: Using the latest plan value can rewrite history for older events.
issue_suggestion: Join to a slowly changing dimension or effective-dated snapshot matching the event time.

title: Do not cast decimal currency to float
description: Parses invoice totals as float before warehouse load.
issue_title: Currency precision is downgraded
issue_description: Floating-point conversion can introduce rounding drift in financial metrics.
issue_suggestion: Use a decimal or fixed-precision numeric type for currency fields.

title: Monitor dropped rows explicitly
description: Skips bad rows with a bare except during ingestion.
issue_title: Bad rows disappear silently
issue_description: The pipeline loses data without any record of how many rows were rejected or why.
issue_suggestion: Send invalid rows to a quarantine sink and emit metrics for failures.

title: Avoid repartitioning every batch by a high-cardinality key
description: Repartitions the dataset by user_id before each write.
code:
df = df.repartition('user_id')
df.write.parquet(output)
issue_title: High-cardinality repartitioning is expensive
issue_description: Repartitioning by a very high-cardinality field can create excessive shuffle cost and many tiny partitions.
issue_suggestion: Partition by a lower-cardinality access dimension or keep the existing distribution when possible.

title: Do not use local timezone for warehouse dates
description: Derives a reporting date using the worker's local timezone.
code:
def report_date(ts):
    return ts.astimezone().date()
issue_title: Date derivation depends on machine locale
issue_description: Different worker environments can classify the same event into different dates.
issue_suggestion: Normalize reporting timestamps in an explicit timezone such as UTC.

title: Preserve source deletes in CDC pipelines
description: Upserts rows from change events but ignores delete operations.
issue_title: Delete events are ignored
issue_description: Warehouse state diverges from the source when deleted records remain forever.
issue_suggestion: Handle delete operations explicitly in the target model.

title: Use stable surrogate keys in dimensions
description: Builds customer dimension keys from email addresses.
code:
def customer_key(row):
    return row['email'].lower()
issue_title: Business key can change over time
issue_description: If a customer changes email, dimensional joins and history can fragment.
issue_suggestion: Use a stable surrogate key or immutable source identifier.

title: Backfill with bounded batches
description: Reads a five-year history into memory before writing.
issue_title: Backfill is unbounded in memory
issue_description: Large historical loads can exhaust worker memory and fail mid-run.
issue_suggestion: Process historical data in bounded chunks or windows.
issue_code:
for window in date_windows(start, end):
    write(source.query(window.sql))

title: Audit PII minimization in derived tables
description: Copies full user profiles into a marketing mart.
code:
def build_marketing_row(user):
    return {'email': user['email'], 'phone': user['phone'], 'ssn': user['ssn']}
issue_title: Derived table contains unnecessary sensitive fields
issue_description: Analytics and marketing marts should not inherit highly sensitive data by default.
issue_suggestion: Include only the fields required for the downstream use case.

title: Check row counts across pipeline stages
description: Loads transformed records without reconciling counts.
issue_title: Pipeline has no reconciliation checkpoint
issue_description: Unexpected row loss or duplication can go unnoticed without stage-level validation.
issue_suggestion: Compare source, transformed, and loaded record counts and alert on mismatches.

title: Represent many-to-many facts explicitly
description: Stores comma-separated tag ids in one column.
code:
def write_article(article):
    warehouse.insert({'article_id': article['id'], 'tag_ids': ','.join(article['tags'])})
issue_title: Many-to-many relationship is flattened into one string
issue_description: Comma-separated ids are hard to query, validate, and join accurately.
issue_suggestion: Write a bridge table with one row per article-tag pair.
issue_code:
for tag_id in article['tags']:
    warehouse.insert({'article_id': article['id'], 'tag_id': tag_id})
